title: Streaming responses stay intact
summary:
One PR kept response tracking out of the stream, made proxy errors more consistent, and widened integration coverage.

Enter now reads a clone when tracking responses, leaving the stream available to the caller. Tracking also handles responses without extractable model usage.

Proxy errors now retain the upstream status and use a consistent format.

Recorded upstream responses, more text-model coverage, and audio-output checks strengthen integration tests.
